_comment: Quest definitions. Stages are visited through set_stage() in dialogue and director rules; see game/story/quests.py.

q_audit.name: The Audit
q_audit.desc: The Meridian Combine wants one word from you: keep Ithaca Station, or close it. The tug returns on Day 6 at 08:00.

stages.report_in: Report to Administrator Osei on the Command Deck, north of the Central Ring.
stages.inspect: See the station for yourself. Speak to Chief Kowal in Engineering, Wren Castellanos in Hydroponics and Dr. Pell in the Medbay.
stages.findings: You have seen all three departments. Take your first impressions back to Administrator Osei.
stages.countdown: The tug docks on Day 6 at 08:00. Whatever your report is going to say, make the station match it before then.
stages.final: The Calypso's Thread has docked. Give your verdict at the main airlock in the Hangar Bay.

q_reactor.name: Keep the Lights On
q_reactor.desc: The fusion reactor is forty years old and losing ground. Chief Kowal can hold it together, but not with empty hands.

stages.parts: Bram needs spare parts. The quartermaster's stores hold some, the fabricator can make more if it gets power and scrap, and you can fit parts yourself at the reactor console.
stages.stabilise: Bring the Fusion Reactor to 85% integrity or better.

outcomes.done: The reactor is holding steady. Bram looked at you as if you might be useful after all.

q_water.name: Pressure Drop
q_water.desc: The main reclamation pump is leaking through a perished seal. The station is drinking its reserve tank dry.

stages.find_seal: Find a replacement pump seal. Dex may have one in stock, Pip might fabricate one from scrap, and Tuck's bore rig uses the same fitting.
stages.fit_seal: You have a pump seal. Fit it at the reclamation pump in Hydroponics, or hand it to Wren.

outcomes.done: The pump runs smooth and the tank gauge has stopped falling.
outcomes.failed: The tanks ran dry before the pump was fixed.

q_medical.name: Missing Doses
q_medical.desc: Stim injectors are disappearing from the medicine cabinet. Dr. Pell wants to know who is not sleeping, and why.

stages.ask_around: Find out who has been taking stims. Somebody on the crew will have noticed.
stages.tuck: Wren says Tuck has not slept properly in weeks. Talk to him at the dig.
stages.decide: Tuck is using stims to stay ahead of his dreams. Decide what Dr. Pell hears.

outcomes.done: The matter of the missing stims is settled, one way or another.

q_smuggler.name: Inventory Shrinkage
q_smuggler.desc: The stores never match the manifests. Somebody is skimming, on a station that cannot spare a ration.

stages.suspect: Find proof of where the missing supplies are going. The quartermaster keeps odd hours.
stages.proof: Dex Marlow is stocking the shuttle Magpie for a run of his own. Decide what to do about it.

outcomes.failed: The Magpie is gone, and Dex and a shuttle-load of supplies with it.

q_signal.name: Something in the Ice
q_signal.desc: The bore broke through into something eight months ago. Nobody has put it in a report.

stages.rumour: The dig found something. Find out what Dr. Suvari is not writing down.
stages.chamber: See the chamber beneath the dig site for yourself. Take a thermal suit.
stages.amplifier: Lin needs the amplifier core to decode the signal. Pip needs the same core to restore comms. Sergeant Halloran has it under lock and key.
stages.waiting: The core has found a home. Now the station waits to see what comes of it.
stages.decoded: Lin has decoded the signal. She is waiting for you in the chamber - and Tuck knows it.

outcomes.done: The question of the artifact has been answered.
outcomes.failed: The chamber is buried under a thousand tonnes of ice.

q_comms.name: Dead Air
q_comms.desc: Ithaca has been deaf and dumb for eight months. Pip is sure the array can be rebuilt.

stages.core: Pip cannot start without the amplifier core.
stages.repairs: Pip is rebuilding the array. Spare parts will speed it up.
stages.power: The array is rebuilt but starved: it sits last in the power queue. Get it powered, then use the comms console on the Command Deck.

outcomes.done: Ithaca Station can talk to the rest of the system again.
